cd units && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, importlib
def load(d, mod):
    sys.path.insert(0, d)
    m = importlib.import_module(mod)
    sys.path.pop(0)
    return m

csv_ = load("csvfix", "impl")
print("csv quote:", csv_.parse('"a,b",2,x'))
print("csv bad cols:", csv_.parse('a,2'), csv_.parse(''))
print("csv total skip blank:", csv_.total([["a","1","2"],["b","2",""]]))
try:
    csv_.total([["a","1","x"]])
    print("csv bad: no raise (BAD)")
except ValueError as e:
    print("csv bad raises:", e)

eng = load("rules", "engine")
print("rules all+any:", eng.evaluate({"all":["a"],"any":["b","a"]}, {"a":True,"b":False}))
print("rules missing key:", eng.evaluate({"all":["zz"]}, {"a":True}))
print("rules empty all/any:", eng.evaluate({"all":[]}, {}), eng.evaluate({"any":[]}, {}))
print("rules no clause:", eng.evaluate({}, {}))

led = load("ledger", "ledger")
L = led.Ledger()
print("ledger filter:", L.apply([("deposit","a",100),("deposit","b",5)], "a"))
print("ledger b balance:", led.balance([("deposit","a",100)], "b"))
try:
    L.apply([("deposit","b",-5)], "a")
    print("ledger other-acct negative: no raise (BAD)")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ledger other-acct negative raises:", e)

sch = load("schedule", "schedule")
print("slots touching:", sch.slots([(0,10),(10,20)], 0))
print("overlaps nested:", sch.overlaps((0,10),(2,3)), sch.overlaps((0,10),(0,10)))

iv = load("intervals", "intervals")
I = iv.Impl()
print("iv merge gap default:", I.merge([[1,2],[3,4]]))
print("iv subtract left/right:", I.subtract([[0,10]],(-5,3)), I.subtract([[0,10]],(7,20)))
print("iv total overlap:", I.total_length([[0,10],[5,6]]))

fl = load("flags", "flags")
F = fl.Impl()
print("flags multi --:", F.parse(["--","--x","--"]))
print("flags short after long:", F.parse(["--mode","-abc"]))
print("flags dash only:", F.parse(["-"]))
PY
